riskiest.overall: BoutiqueAmp (least tested, discontinuous waveshaper, all guards missing)
riskiest.worstSingleFailureMode: HighGainAmp NaN-latched gate envelope -> persistent silence

carryOver: Release VST3 build + manual DAW PDC null test (P13A)

irGenerator.design: delta -> 8-9 cascaded biquads (double-precision design) -> 2 comb reflections (SR-scaled delays) -> exponential decay (per-sample rate) -> normalize 0.85 peak; ~23 ms duration constant across SR (unit-tested)

findings.title: No oversize-block guard before oversampler.processSamplesUp
findings.evidence: JUCE Oversampling buffers are sized by initProcessing(samplesPerBlock); a larger host block overruns them (assert in debug, heap corruption in release). CleanAmp's emergencySafePass comment (CleanAmp.h:192) names this exact scenario; cabinets and Neural have canProcessBlock guards; the P1 oversized-fallback test covers the three cabinets but no amp.
findings.recommendedFix: Add canProcessBlock-style dry fallback (or CleanAmp emergencySafePass) before upsampling; extend runP1OversizedFallback to all five amps.

findings.title: No NaN/Inf input scrub; HighGainAmp gate envelope latches NaN into persistent silence
findings.evidence: CleanAmp scrubs and all cabinets scrub; these four amps do not. NaN latches IIR states and sag/cathode/gate envelopes. HighGainAmp worst case: inputNoiseEnvelope (HighGainAmp.h:217-233) latches NaN, the resulting NaN gain multiplies the signal, conditionPreampInput converts NaN to 0 - output stays silent until reset/auto-heal.
findings.recommendedFix: Add input scrub + finite guards on envelopes (P13B-FIX1 pattern) plus two-phase NaN latch/recovery tests, explicitly covering the HighGainAmp gate case.

findings.title: Missing ScopedNoDenormals in processBlock (7 processors)
findings.evidence: Only CleanAmp guards (plus input denormal flush). IIR tails, sag/cathode envelopes, and convolution tails decay through the denormal range - CPU spikes on hosts without FTZ. Exact P13B F-001 pattern, fixed for stateful FX in P13B-FIX1 but not extended to amps/cabs.
findings.recommendedFix: Seven one-line ScopedNoDenormals additions at top of processBlock.

findings.title: Sample-rate-dependent time constants in envelopes and IR decay
findings.evidence: AMP_SAG_DECAY=0.9992 per-sample at inner rate (Constants.h:135); ChimeAmp cathodeBiasCoeff=0.0012 and sag 0.9988 fixed; BoutiqueAmp envAttack/envRelease constexpr with comments claiming 4x/176.4kHz while code runs 8x; SyntheticIR decayRate per-sample so IR tail decay time halves at 96k (IR window length itself is SR-constant and unit-tested).
findings.recommendedFix: Derive envelope coefficients from inner rate in prepare; convert IR decay to a per-second constant. A/B by ear first (listening item L13).

findings.title: Latency rounding inconsistency (truncation vs ceil vs round)
findings.evidence: (int)oversampler.getLatencyInSamples() truncates in these four; CleanAmp uses ceil; Neural uses round. Sub-sample under-report only.
findings.recommendedFix: Standardize on std::round in the FIX1 pass.

findings.title: Output-safety inconsistency across cabinets and uncontained amp masters
findings.evidence: Atlas has containCabinetOutput (soft knee to 0.97), Modern has 0.70 wet trim, Vintage2x12 has neither (level up to 2x on IR output whose frequency-domain gain can exceed 1 plus +-12 dB shelves). ClassicAmp/BoutiqueAmp have no output limiter at master <=2 with up to +6-7.6 dB shelf boosts - bounded by tanh stage sums but can push 2-6x theoretical peaks into OutputChain (always-on limiter backstops).
findings.recommendedFix: Harmonize after listening test L7: trim/containment for Vintage2x12; optional CleanAmp-style softLimit on Classic/Boutique masters.

findings.title: Discontinuous piecewise waveshaper at cleanThreshold
findings.evidence: At threshold t=0.6: polynomial branch yields 0.557, tanh branch yields 0.526 (~6% step); t=0.52 yields ~5% step. Signal straddling the threshold steps per-sample, producing crackle/spurious harmonics exactly in the amp's signature edge-of-breakup zone.
findings.recommendedFix: Match branch values/derivatives at the threshold or crossfade between branches. Verify by ear (listening item L12).

findings.title: Header comments claim 4x oversampling; code runs 8x
findings.evidence: Oversampling(2, 3) = 2^3 = 8x; innerRate = sr*8. Comments in both headers (and Boutique envelope-coefficient comments) say 4x/176.4 kHz.

findings.title: Async IR install leaves brief EQ-only window
findings.evidence: loadImpulseResponse installs on a background thread; getCurrentIRSize()==0 guard skips convolution until ready, so the first block(s) pass with voicing EQ but no IR. Masked by engine startup-silence counters.

latencyPdcSummary.amps: All five report oversampler latency via setProcessingLatency; bypass toggles N<->0 through the verified P13A-F001 listener path (tests AudioEngineTests.cpp:4514, :5710). Rounding convention inconsistent (F-005).
latencyPdcSummary.cabinets: Zero latency (default JUCE convolution engine) - correctly report nothing.

testGaps: No oversize-block test for the five amps (cabinets covered)
No NaN/Inf injection tests for amps (HighGainAmp gate latch is the key case)
BoutiqueAmp/ChimeAmp covered only by generic p11a guards - no chain/hot-input/automation tests
No SR-consistency test for envelope feel (F-004)
No sustained-limiter-abuse test for ClassicAmp/Boutique at master 2
recommendedNextStep: Codex 5.5 implements P13C-FIX1 (oversize guards, NaN scrub + envelope guards, ScopedNoDenormals x7, latency rounding, comment fixes) with matching tests; tone-affecting F-004/F-006/F-007 deferred behind the listening matrix. Then proceed to the drive/dynamics audit.
